classification.source_level_rationale: The records are verbatim video recordings of parliamentary debates, created at the time of the events by the National Council.
classification.resume: The document comprises three video recordings from the National Council's Question Hour (Fragestunde) during the spring session of 2012, addressing adjustments to the foreign price comparison of medicines, the Federal Council's stance on the Office of Public Health's proposal, and currency adjustment impacts on premium payers.
